svg.title: DIA-006A · A proof, marked for omissions
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a printer's proof sheet with a red pencil lying on it. Five industry claims are printed down the left as quotations, from Marc Andreessen, Marc Benioff, the Anthropic mission, Yann LeCun and Dario Amodei. Nothing is struck out. Each quotation ends in a red caret, the proof-reader's mark for something left out, and the omission is written beside it in the margin in red pencil.
svg.text: PLATE VI
PART I · SECTION 6 · WHAT'S ACTUALLY AT STAKE
as printed
in the reader's pencil
I. PESSIMISTS HAVE ALWAYS BEEN WRONG
“AI is math, code, computers, built and
controlled by people. A mind of its own that
decides to kill us is a superstitious handwave.”^
Marc Andreessen, a16z, June 2023
The structural issue isn't the prediction.
It's whether the system can catch
its own failures.
Past panics met oversight that grew with them:
SEC, OSHA, FDA. CAISI has $10M for FY2026.
II. AI CREATES MORE JOBS THAN IT DESTROYS
“AI will create more jobs than it eliminates,
just as every previous technology has.”^
Marc Benioff, Salesforce, 2025
The aggregate figure is probably correct,
and almost beside the point.
The structural problem is timing and distribution.
See DIA-006B.
III. LABS GENUINELY CARE ABOUT SAFETY
“The responsible development and maintenance
of advanced AI for the long-term benefit
of humanity.”^
Anthropic mission
The safety teams are real. The loop
is the problem, not the people.
Even safety-focused labs can't hold the line
unilaterally if competitors won't.
IV. OPEN-SOURCE DEMOCRATIZES AI
“Concentration of power through proprietary
AI systems is a much bigger danger
than everything else.”^
Yann LeCun, Lex Fridman #416, March 2024
The access argument is real. The power
argument is more complicated.
Who extracts value tracks who has the compute.
Organizations and states outpace individuals.
V. SLOWING DOWN HANDS THE LEAD TO RIVALS
“If a country like the PRC ends up with the
most powerful AI systems, this could be more
dangerous than any other risk we face.”^
Dario Amodei, “Machines of Loving Grace,” October 2024
The race is treated as exogenous.
It is being constructed.
Race-as-given forecloses cooperative
arrangements not yet seriously tried.
A Proof, Marked for Omissions
The caret is a proof-reader's mark for something left out. Nothing on the sheet is struck through.
DIA-006A · Five industry claims in their own words, and what each leaves out.
